constraints.name: phase4_assignment_orders_current_assignment_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((assignment_state = ANY (ARRAY['assigned'::text, 'accepted'::text, 'handed_off'::text])) AND (((assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(btrim(assigned_agent_id)) > 0) AND (assigned_agent_name IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(btrim(assigned_agent_name)) >= 2) AND (assigned_cabiniste_id IS NULL) AND (assigned_cabiniste_name IS NULL)) OR ((assigned_agent_id IS NULL) AND (assigned_agent_name IS NULL) AND (assigned_cabiniste_id IS NOT NULL) AND (assigned_cabiniste_name IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(btrim(assigned_cabiniste_name)) >= 2))) AND (assigned_by_uid IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(btrim(assigned_by_uid)) > 0) AND (assignment_mode IS NOT NULL) AND (assigned_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((assignment_state = ANY (ARRAY['waiting'::text, 'manual_required'::text, 'closed'::text])) AND (assigned_agent_id IS NULL) AND (assigned_agent_name IS NULL) AND (assigned_cabiniste_id IS NULL) AND (assigned_cabiniste_name IS NULL) AND (assignment_mode IS NULL) AND (assigned_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: phase4_assignment_orders_handoff_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((assignment_state = 'handed_off'::text) AND (firebase_handoff_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (assignment_state <> 'handed_off'::text)))

constraints.name: phase4_assignment_orders_single_executor_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((assigned_agent_id IS NULL) OR (assigned_cabiniste_id IS NULL)))

constraints.name: territory_zones_coordinates_pair
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((latitude IS NULL) AND (longitude IS NULL)) OR (((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (latitude <= (90)::double precision)) AND ((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (longitude <= (180)::double precision)))))
